'''The Extreme''' was the name given to the stretch of the [[Elrood-Derilyn Trade Route]] that connected the [[Torina system/Legends|Torina system]] to the [[Derilyn system/Legends|Derilyn system]]. Due to [[Derilyn]] being placed under martial law, and the establishment of [[Imperial Interdicted Space]], [[Starship/Legends|starships]] traveling The Extreme were more than likely to be stopped by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] patrols and be harassed, boarded, or even confiscated. Since the risks of traveling The Extreme far outweighed the benefits, trade along that portion of the Elrood-Derilyn Trade Route was almost non-existent during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
